$$

---

### Key Mathematical Insight

A fundamental property of exponents is that:

$$
a^b = \underbrace{a \times a \times \cdots \times a}_{b \text{ times}}
$$

When the base $a = 1$, regardless of the exponent $b$, the result is always:

$$
1^b = 1
$$

This is because multiplying 1 by itself any number of times still yields 1.

---

### Applying This to the Problem

$$
1^{(2^{235423523})} = 1
$$
